when the economy picks up.definition:
Common beginning or ending to a sentence. It can serve to:

1. provide an excuse for why one has not yet done something.\r
2. suggest a vague intention of doing something later (similar to how Spanish speakers use the word "mañana.")\r
3. add minimal credibility to an idea that is a pipe dream.
> 1. There's no point in looking for a job until the economy picks up.
> 2. I'll start my business when the economy picks up.
> 3. Unemployment levels will go back down to the levels they were in the late 1990s when the economy picks up.

where is this coming from.definition:
An excuse used by shitty people to deny ownership or knowledge of their bad qualities. Can also be used to devalue and avoid change or responsibility over what the other person said to them. In either case, the speaker feigns surprise at these "new" and "unexpected" things they are being told.

Translates directly into "you've taken all my shit before, why the sudden backbone?" and/or "I've known this for awhile, but why bring it up now?"
> Ellie: You lie to my face and behind my back, we only hang out when you need something, you ditch me the second you get a boyfriend and come running back the second he leaves you, and you give me your clothes that are too tight and then tell people you gave them to me because they were too big. You're a bad friend, and I'm so done with you.
> Christie: Whoah, where is this coming from?
> Dan: We've been friends for a long time and obviously you know I like you because I go above and beyond the call of duty of friendship, so now that you're single, maybe we can go on a date?
> Jamie: A date? Like romantic? But you're my friend. Where is this coming from?

wherewith.translation: adv. 用那个, 以其, 用什么

wherewithal.definition: n. the necessary means (especially financial means)
wherewithal.translation:
n. 必要的资金
[法] 必要的方法, 必要物

wherries.translation: n. 载客舢板( wherry的名词复数 ); 内河船

wherry.definition:
n. sailing barge used especially in East Anglia
n. light rowboat for use in racing or for transporting goods and passengers in inland waters and harbors
wherry.translation:
n. 浅水客货船, 单人双浆小赛艇
vt. 用驳船运

whet.definition:
v. make keen or more acute
v. sharpen by rubbing, as on a whetstone
whet.translation:
n. 磨, 开胃小吃
vt. 磨, 磨快, 刺激, 促进

whether.definition:
pron. Which (of two); which one (of two); -- used
   interrogatively and relatively.
conj. In case; if; -- used to introduce the first or two or
   more alternative clauses, the other or others being connected by or, or
   by or whether. When the second of two alternatives is the simple
   negative of the first it is sometimes only indicated by the particle
   not or no after the correlative, and sometimes it is omitted entirely
   as being distinctly implied in the whether of the first.
whether.translation:
conj. 是否, 不论
pron. 两个中的哪一个

whether or no.translation: 不管怎样, 无论如何

whethering.definition: n. The retention of the afterbirth in cows.
whethering.translation:
conj. 是否：；不管…还是…：
pron. [古语](两者中的)哪一个；(两者中的)任何一个
a. [古语](两者中的)哪一个；(两者中的)任何一个

whets.definition:
v make keen or more acute
v sharpen by rubbing, as on a whetstone
whets.translation: v. （在石头上）磨（刀、斧等）( whet的第三人称单数 ); 引起, 刺激（食欲、欲望、兴趣等）

whew.definition:

n. 吹哨声

whewellite.definition:

whewer.translation: interj. [象声词]哎唷![表示惊讶、厌恶、恐惧等的感叹语]

wheyface.definition: n. One who is pale, as from fear.

wheys.definition:
plural of whey
